summary.text: Victoria Sullivan is a Republican state senator from Manchester, New Hampshire, who has represented District 18 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Her career experience includes serving as director of the nonprofit Freedom Staffing.

paragraphs.text: Sullivan attended Medway High School and Northern Essex Community College.
Her career experience includes working as the director of the nonprofit Freedom Staffing, and she served as a selectman in Manchester, New Hampshire, from 2013 to 2015.
She served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 16 from 2014 to 2018 and assumed office in the State Senate on December 4, 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session Sullivan is vice chair of the Children and Family Law Committee and the Senate Education Committee and serves on the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
